title: Design optimization: geometry and parameters, re-verified on refined meshes
description: Geometry dimensions and parameters of a tool (a gmsh-parametrized cantilever solved by plane-stress FEM by default) optimised under constraints; the optimum re-solved on refined meshes (Richardson, grid convergence index), the coarse-mesh error corrected, checks on convergence, constraints, sensitivities, robustness and the known optimum, and the STEP of the optimum (pinneapple_design.design_optimizer.workflow).
